picks.title: Introducing Runway Ruby
picks.excerpt: Runway Ruby is a new model that generates 16-bit HDR ProRes and EXR sequences, or converts existing clips into them — pushing generative video into finishing-grade formats that film pipelines actually ingest.
picks.rationale: First generative model that outputs finishing-grade 16-bit HDR ProRes/EXR, so generated footage can enter a real conform and grade instead of stopping at 8-bit web delivery.

picks.title: Nikola Todorovic on the latest developments in Autodesk's Flow Studio
picks.excerpt: Flow Studio (ex-Wonder Dynamics) adds a 3D Editor + Canvas: a single workspace for generation, scene assembly, rendering and refinement, aimed at giving filmmakers shot-level control over AI output.
picks.rationale: Autodesk puts generation, scene assembly and rendering in one 3D workspace — the shot-level control layer most AI video tools still lack, straight from the product lead.

picks.title: Caira gets AI generative video editing feature
picks.excerpt: Camera Intelligence's Caira adds generative video editing driven by Gemini and Runway Aleph, moving prompt-based shot manipulation onto the camera itself rather than into post.
picks.rationale: Prompt-based shot manipulation moves from post onto the camera body — a genuinely new place in the pipeline for generative editing, and fresh today.

picks.title: Eddie AI Launches an Agent Marketplace of Editing Agents Built on Great Filmmakers
picks.excerpt: Eddie AI's new Agent Marketplace offers assistant-editing agents built on the stated rules of well-known editors and directors, letting cutters swap in a named editorial point of view.
picks.rationale: Editorial style becomes a selectable agent — a distinct new release (not the August pricing/MCP overhaul) that changes how an assistant edit gets briefed.

picks.title: Danny Boyle speaks out against AI proliferation: "It's insane what we're doing"
picks.excerpt: At Venice for 'Ink', Danny Boyle argues the industry's rush into generative tools is corroding the verification work that journalism — and filmmaking — depends on.
picks.rationale: Balances four tool releases with the craft argument from a major director at Venice — the verification cost of generative media, stated on the record today.
